name: SADIB (Sayangi Dosenmu Ingatkan Beliau)
overview: SADIB is a short animated film that portrays a group of outstanding lecturers at SADIB campus. Their brilliance makes it difficult for students to fully understand them—or even to communicate with them. A barrier exists there. The director interprets this barrier as a form of affection. SADIB stands for Sayangi Dosenmu Ingatkan Beliau (“Love Your Lecturer, Remind Them of......”) the dots are to be filled with the title of each episode.
